Priya: Heads-up: screen reader audit on the compact Dashboard revealed a couple of regressions — legend items aren't announced and the compact header loses visible focus when tabbing. Screenshot + VoiceOver notes attached.
Liam: Thanks. Which builds? Prod or staging?
Priya: Staging (build 2026.03.18). VoiceOver on macOS and NVDA quick check on Windows.
Noor: Repro'd on Chrome + VoiceOver. Legend markers are built as <span> with role=presentation, so SRs skip the label.
Priya: Right. Also keyboard nav: tab lands inside the chart canvas before the legend, so users don't get series context.
ops-bot: Deploy-check: staging branch "dashboard/compact-a11y" deployed 1774110002 by @Liam.
a11y-bot: Automated scan (1774110020): failures: color-contrast (metric-chip 3.1:1), aria-roles (legend items missing role/button and aria-pressed), focus-visible (card header has no focus indicator).
Liam: Quick fixes idea: make legend entries <button aria-pressed=\"true|false\"> with visually-hidden labels for series value; change metric-chip color to #e8f2ff on dark theme, bump size to 13px; restore focus via :focus-visible for header.
Noor: Agree. Also add tabindex=\"0\" to legend buttons so they appear in tab order before canvas. We should avoid tabindex traps; keep natural DOM order by moving legend before canvas.
Priya: For screen reader text, add `aria-label=\"Toggle series: <name>, currently on\"` or use `aria-pressed` so it's concise.
Liam: Will open RDW-8033 with the proposed CSS + semantic changes. Plan: tiny DOM reorder, update legend to button, CSS color + :focus-visible, add role=\"status\" for toast messages.
Priya: Can we get a quick smoke test after PR? 5-7 mins VoiceOver + NVDA.
Noor: I can run NVDA. Priya can do VoiceOver. Liam, ping when deployed to staging.
Liam: Will do. Also adding a checklist entry to design docs: "Charts: legend must be keyboard accessible + announced by SRs".
Priya: Nice. Marking this as blocker for the compact Dashboard release until RDW-8033 is merged. :white_check_mark:
a11y-bot: Reminder scheduled: full screen-reader audit on Friday 14:00 UTC.
